profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer @ Fidelity Investments | Certified Azure AI Engineer Associate | MSCS @ Georgia Tech
profile.summary:
Backend Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments building scalable, reliable technology for the financial services industry. I develop backend systems and APIs with a focus on performance, maintainability, and secure, high-quality software.

I earned a B.S. in Business Administration with a concentration in Information Technology from NC State University, giving me a strong foundation in both technology and business. I’m passionate about backend architecture, cloud technologies, and building solutions that enhance the client experience in fintech.

positions.title: Pharmacy Technician
positions.description:
- Assist pharmacists in preparing prescription medications for customers.
- Process and fill prescriptions accurately and efficiently.
- Maintain inventory levels by ordering necessary medications and supplies.
- Receive and stock pharmaceuticals, ensuring proper storage and handling.
- Provide excellent customer service by addressing inquiries and concerns regarding medications and health products.
- Operate and maintain pharmacy equipment, such as pill counters and computer systems.
- Perform administrative tasks, including processing insurance claims and maintaining patient records.
- Follow all federal and state pharmacy regulations and maintain compliance with CVS policies and procedures.
- Collaborate with other healthcare professionals to ensure optimal patient care.
- Educate patients on medication usage, potential side effects, and drug interactions.
- Participate in ongoing training and professional development to stay informed about new medications and pharmacy practices.

positions.title: Fast Food Team Member
positions.locationName: Wake Forest, North Carolina, United States
positions.description:
- Provide exceptional customer service by greeting guests, taking orders accurately, and ensuring a positive dining experience.
- Prepare and serve food according to Chick-fil-A standards, including cooking chicken, assembling sandwiches, and packaging meals.
- Maintain cleanliness and sanitation standards in the dining area, kitchen, and food preparation areas.
- Operate kitchen equipment safely and efficiently, following proper procedures and protocols.
- Work collaboratively with team members to ensure smooth operations during peak hours and busy periods.
- Handle cash and card transactions accurately, including operating the cash register and processing payments.
- Uphold Chick-fil-A's core values and customer service principles at all times.
- Assist with inventory management, including stocking supplies, rotating products, and monitoring expiration dates.
- Follow food safety guidelines and procedures to prevent cross-contamination and ensure food quality and freshness.
- Participate in training programs and workshops to enhance skills and knowledge of Chick-fil-A products and processes.
- Communicate effectively with team members and management to address any issues or concerns promptly.
positions.insights: Skills: Oral Communication · Time Management · Thinking Skills · Problem Solving · Interpersonal Skills · Written Communication · Collaborative Problem Solving · Customer Service · Communication · Attention to Detail

positions.title: Stocker
positions.description:
- Receive incoming shipments of merchandise, including groceries, perishables, and non-food items.
- Unload delivery trucks and transport items to designated storage areas within the store.
- Stock shelves and displays with merchandise, ensuring products are neatly organized and properly rotated.
- Monitor inventory levels and replenish stock as needed to meet customer demand.
- Check product quality and freshness, removing any damaged or expired items from shelves.
- Maintain cleanliness and organization in the stockroom and throughout the store, including sweeping, mopping, and disposing of trash.
- Follow safety procedures and guidelines while handling merchandise and operating equipment, such as pallet jacks and forklifts.
- Assist customers with locating items and providing information about product availability.
- Collaborate with other team members to achieve departmental goals and ensure efficient store operations.
- Adhere to Food Lion's policies and procedures regarding stocking, merchandising, and customer service.
- Participate in training programs and workshops to enhance product knowledge and develop skills relevant to the role.
- Communicate effectively with supervisors and colleagues to address any issues or concerns related to stocking and inventory management.

positions.title: Store Cashier
positions.description:
- Greet customers with a friendly and welcoming demeanor as they enter the store.
- Scan items accurately and efficiently at the checkout counter using a barcode scanner or manual entry.
- Process cash, credit card, debit card, and mobile payment transactions accurately, adhering to Food Lion's cash handling policies.
- Bag groceries neatly and efficiently, taking care to separate fragile items and heavy items appropriately.
- Assist customers with locating items and answering inquiries about product availability, prices, and promotions.
- Verify age-restricted purchases, such as alcohol and tobacco products, in accordance with state and federal regulations.
